scope: Bounded same-grid Minkowski controls; no puncture, 100M, AMR or convergence admission
fit_selection: Unchanged frozen growth() function: longest contiguous amplitude window1e-10..1e-3, four samples minimum
accuracy: Sampled complete closure has roughly third-order measured manufactured rates; no fourth-order accuracy claim
norms: Reported formulation H and invariant conformal M, normalized compactified coordinate-volume RMS; no H fit near roundoff
timing_caveat: Cumulative timing buckets overlap and are independently MPI_MAX reduced; they cannot be summed or subtracted as disjoint wall time. Closure includes surface gathers also charged to exchange; V4/V5 add the 21-field residual gather. V5 additionally includes provisional local halo filling and five native numerator samples per row. Diagnostics contain a boundary refresh. Per-accepted-step cumulative values amortize initialization, diagnostics and failed-stage work, and are not isolated kernel timings. Full-step history rates include diagnostics; these separate allocations do not establish a causal GPU throughput improvement.

growth.selection: longest contiguous recorded state_deviation interval in [1e-10,1e-3]; earliest tie
growth.caveat: Correlated diagnostic samples: OLS error is descriptive, not a confidence interval. Growth rates are not inferred from failure times.
